summary: Tested new voucher/discount-code feature on paywall (backend POST /api/vouchers/validate + frontend paywall.tsx UI). Backend: 8/8 pytest cases pass covering case-insensitivity, not_found/inactive/expired/limit_reached/not_applicable reasons, PROONLY plan restriction, auth requirement, and confirmed redemption_count is NEVER incremented by validate calls. Frontend: full E2E flow verified via Playwright on mobile viewport (375x667) -- login, navigate to paywall, expand voucher toggle, apply WELCOME20 (success badge + success line with -20%), apply EXPIRED10 (distinct inline error, badge cleared), switching plan clears voucher state, PROONLY correctly gated to yearly_individual plan only, CTA note correctly appends '(code: WELCOME20)', and all voucher UI strings render correctly in EN/DE/ES. No bugs found.
action_items: Optional wording nit (not a bug): success message key pw.voucherSuccess reads 'Code redeemed' (EN) / 'Code eingelöst' (DE) / 'Código aplicado' (ES) which implies redemption, though the feature explicitly only validates/displays and never redeems. Consider 'Code applied' wording for EN/DE consistency with pw.voucherApplied ('Code applied') to avoid user confusion that the code was actually redeemed. Purely cosmetic, no functional impact.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend validate_voucher logic is clean and correctly ordered (not_found -> inactive -> expired -> limit_reached -> not_applicable -> valid), matches spec exactly.
Frontend correctly clears appliedVoucher/voucherError on plan change (onPress of plan Pressable), and correctly gates badge display to only the currently selected plan (active && appliedVoucher).

No real redemption call exists anywhere in the codebase (grep confirmed only validate_voucher touches discount_codes reads; no increment of redemption_count) -- consistent with placeholder purchase flow intent.
seed_data_creation: None created; reused the 5 pre-seeded discount codes (WELCOME20, EXPIRED10, INACTIVE5, MAXEDOUT, PROONLY) already present in MongoDB discount_codes collection.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Voucher feature fully verified end-to-end (backend + frontend, EN/DE/ES). No regressions found in plan selection, pricing display, or placeholder purchase()/restore() flows. Demo user (demo@tradequest.app) is on 7-day Pro trial (pro_source=trial), so paywall still renders plan list (isPremium check requires pro_source==='subscription').
